title: Fascia presentation, signed part
description: The second part of the Fascia-Presentation header: v1.<this object, canonical JSON (RFC 8785), base64url>.<device signature over those bytes, base64url>.<claims: DAG-CBOR array of chains, each an array of UCAN delegation bytes root first, base64url>. The whole header is at most 8,192 bytes and carries at most 4 chains.

path.description: Request target with query, byte for byte as the service receives it.

iat.description: Unix seconds, corrected by the device's stored clock offset.

claims_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the claims part's bytes. Binds the claims to the signature.
